title: Assam 2026 monsoon flood replay (synthetic)
description: Synthetic replay inspired by Assam monsoon floods - not real observations. A 72-hour build-up in which rain over Guwahati and Dibrugarh reaches 200-250 mm/24 h and the Brahmaputra rises from about its 80th percentile past GloFAS danger and extreme thresholds; Patna sees a milder Ganga rise. Other cities show a real Open-Meteo snapshot captured 2026-11-11. Every frame is scored by the real JalRakshak risk engine, and the agent runs and alerts were produced by the real agent pipeline.
